title: Optimistic Updates
subtitle: Instant UI with rollback on failure
description: Flip source early on save; restore previous source if the mutation fails (draft kept).
content: Enable with `mutation.optimistic`. Useful for snappy admin UIs; pair with clear error feedback.

sections.title: Boolean optimistic
sections.content: Applies the current draft as the new source immediately, then calls `source.save`:

sections.title: Custom mapper
sections.content: Derive optimistic source from draft + previous:

sections.title: Failure behavior
sections.content: On error, source rolls back to the previous value. Draft overrides are kept so the user does not lose edits. Check `mutation.error` / `onSaveError`.
